learning_outcomes.text: Students will find the convergence of sequences and series and the interval of convergence of power series.
Students will gain the ability to use vector algebra in three-dimensional space and in the plane, and to write plane and line equations.

Students will gain the ability to understand the concepts of limit and continuity in multivariable functions, calculate partial derivatives, find tangent planes, directional derivatives, and gradients.
Students will gain the ability to solve extremum problems with the second derivative test.
Students will solve double integrals and use double integrals in calculating area and volume.

syllabus_topics: Multivariable Functions: Functions of Two and Three Variables: Domain and Range Sets, Graphs, Level Curves and Level Surfaces, Limit and Continuity in Functions of Two Variables (Double Path Test for Non-existence of Limit, Continuity of Composite Functions)

A Brief Look at Quadratic Surfaces (plane, sphere, ellipsoid, elliptic paraboloid, cylinder, cone), Functions of More Than Two Variables. Partial Derivatives: Partial Derivatives of Functions of Two and Three Variables, Partial Derivative and Continuity, Second Order Partial Derivatives and Equality of Mixed Derivatives, Higher Order Partial Derivatives, Differentiability

Chain Rule for Functions of Two and Three Variables [For Functions with One and Two Independent Variables], Implicit Differentiation [for f(x,y)=0 and F(x,y,z)=0 for ∂f/∂x, ∂f/∂y, etc.]. Directional Derivatives and Gradient Vector: Definition and Calculation of Directional Derivative in the Plane, Gradient Vector, Tangents of Level Curves and Gradients, Directional Derivative in Space

Tangent Planes and Differentials: Tangent Plane and Normal Line of a Surface. Linearizing a Function of Two Variables, Differentials, Extremum Values: Local Extremum Values, Necessary Conditions for Local Extremum Values, Critical and Saddle Points, Second Derivative Test for Local Extremum Values.
Multiple Integrals: Double Integrals over Rectangles, Double Integrals as Volume, Calculation of Double Integrals: Fubini's Theorem (First Form), Double Integrals over General Regions

Double Integrals over Non-Rectangular Bounded Regions, Volumes (volume between two surfaces), Fubini's Theorem (More Comprehensive Form). Finding Integration Limits, Using Vertical Cross-Sections, Using Horizontal Cross-Sections, Properties of Double Integrals, Area Calculation in Double Integrals

Mean Value Theorem. Double Integrals in Polar Form: Finding Integration Limits, Converting Cartesian Integrals to Polar Integrals, Volume calculation using polar coordinates (volume between two surfaces)

Variable Transformation in Double Integrals. Vector-Valued Functions in Space: Definition, Limit and Continuity of Vector-Valued Functions, Derivatives (Velocity and Acceleration Vectors), Arc Length Along a Space Curve, Vector Fields.

Line Integrals: Line Integral of Vector Fields, Line Integral with Respect to Coordinates. Infinite Sequences: Convergence and Divergence of Sequences (definitions), Calculation of Limits of Sequences, Squeeze Theorem for Sequences, Continuous Function Theorem for Sequences

Common Limits, Recursively Defined Sequences, Bounded Monotonic Sequences, Monotonic Sequence Theorem. Infinite Series: Geometric Series, nth Term Test for Divergent Series, Combining Series, Adding or Deleting Terms, Convergence Tests for Positive Term Series: Integral Test, p-Series, Harmonic Series
Quiz; Harmonic Series, Comparison Test, Limit Comparison Test. Ratio and Root Tests. Alternating Series, Alternating Series Test

Absolute and Conditional Convergence. Power Series: Radius of Convergence of a Power Series, Derivative and Integral of Power Series, Taylor and Maclaurin Series: Maclaurin and Taylor Polynomials, Maclaurin and Taylor Series.
Applications of Taylor Series: Approximate Value Calculation, Limit Calculation, Calculation of Non-Elementary Integrals
